title: YOUR FACEBOOK ADS
*ARE WASTING MONEY*
slides.sub: Five signs to check if you run them yourself.

title: 400 LIKES.
*ZERO CALLS.*
slides.body: A Joondalup plumber boosts a post for AUD$200. The likes roll in. The phone stays quiet.

title: YOU HIT THE
*BOOST BUTTON*
slides.body: The Boost button chases likes and views. Likes don't pay the bills. Run your ads in Ads Manager with leads or calls as the goal.

title: YOU EDIT
*EVERY MORNING*
slides.body: Meta needs about 50 results in 7 days to learn who buys. Every big edit restarts that learning. Leave the ad alone for a week.

title: NO PIXEL ON
*YOUR WEBSITE*
slides.body: Without the Meta pixel, Meta never learns who filled in your form. So Meta keeps finding people who scroll straight past.

title: CLICKS LAND ON
*YOUR HOMEPAGE*
slides.body: Sarah in Rockingham taps your ad for a bathroom quote. She lands on your homepage and leaves. Send her to one page with one form.

title: YOU FIX ADS
*AT 10PM*
slides.body: A full day of jobs, then an hour in Ads Manager at night. (Romantic.) An hour a night is 7 hours a week you're not billing.

title: *RECAP*
items: Leave each ad alone for 7 days
Send clicks to one page with one form
Hand your ads off if they eat your evenings

title: WANT A
*FREE AUDIT?*
slides.body: Send us a DM and I'll check your Facebook and Instagram ads for free.
